description: An elegant, professional, and unique UI system tailored for EnlaceHR ISP (jupiterisp.net). It moves away from generic 'AI slop' by utilizing a 'Celestial / Luxury Tech' aesthetic. High contrast, refined typography, and meticulous responsive design.

rules.labels_overlines: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-body text-muted-foreground

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border border-white/10 dark:border-white/5 shadow-lg
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain overlay (bg-noise) at 3-5% opacity on main backgrounds to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40). For active/selected states, use primary color borders (border-primary/50).
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-xl for cards/dialogs, rounded-full for buttons/badges to keep it elegant.

responsive_strategy.mobile: 0-767px: Sidebar becomes Drawer/Sheet. Tables convert to stacked cards. Dialogs become full-screen Sheets or w-full Dialogs. Header compress to Logo + Icons.
responsive_strategy.tablet: 768-1023px: Sidebar collapsed to icons. Grids are 2-column.
responsive_strategy.desktop: 1024px+: Expanded sidebar. Complex Bento grids (3-4 columns).

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 or gap-8 in main grids. Avoid cramped UI.

component_guidelines.sidebar: Mobile: Use shadcn Sheet component triggered by hamburger icon. Desktop: Fixed collapsible layout with subtle right border.
component_guidelines.header: MUST have background (solid or glassmorphism), NEVER fully transparent. Mobile: Hide text labels on calculator/messages, use icons with badges.
component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Use 'The Hero' Bento grid span. Include large serif numbers, subtle primary-colored icons, and a micro-trend chart (recharts) or percentage badge.
component_guidelines.tables_to_cards: CRITICAL: For screens <768px, hide the standard HTML table structure. Map over the data array to render a stacked list of Card components. Each card displays column headers as labels on the left and values on the right.
component_guidelines.smart_life_device: Mobile: grid-cols-1 or 2. Desktop: grid-cols-3 or 4. Active (ON) state: Add subtle glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]) and primary border. Use framer-motion for sliders.
component_guidelines.dialogs: Mobile: Add 'sm:max-w-[425px] w-[95vw] h-[90vh] sm:h-auto overflow-y-auto' to ensure they don't overflow viewport.
component_guidelines.badges: Tricolor badges should be muted and elegant. Instead of standard bg-green-500, use bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Hover state must have a clear transition (e.g., hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md).

motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. e.g., transition-transform duration-300 ease-out. NO 'transition-all'.
motion.stagger: List items and table cards should stagger in using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons meets APCA. Use dark text on gold/primary background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='client-card-12').

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings; stick to the Serif chosen (Playfair).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look by utilizing negative space, distinct typography, and the deep blue/gold palette.
Replace generic placeholders with actual data or contextual mock data.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard React JS with PropTypes or JSDoc if types are needed.
Read this JSON and apply the colors as CSS variables in globals.css/index.css under :root and .dark.
Add 'Playfair Display', 'Manrope', and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.html.
Prioritize fixing the mobile responsive issues first: implement the Sidebar Sheet, Table-to-Card logic, and Header compression.
When modifying Shadcn components, adjust their styling in the component files to match the elegant radii (rounded-xl) and borders.
DO NOT strip out existing functional logic (RBAC, API calls, tests); ONLY wrap them in the new UI/UX components.
Add data-testid to every new button, input, tab, or card you touch.
